CustomField.description: Snapshot of Order.Excluded From Allocation, copied when the allocation of record is created (Allocation_TriggerHandler.setAllocationStrategies). Checked when this sleeve sat outside the model: its dollars came off the account value before the other sleeves' target weights were calculated. Carried forward so a completed allocation still says what it meant without re-resolving the strategy's current Sleeve Basis Rule.
CustomField.label: Excluded From Allocation
